paragraphs: R. Neḥunya of the valley of Beit Tortan; R. Yoḥanan spoke in his name, Mo'ed Katan 3b; Ta'anit 3a; Sukkah 44a; Zevaḥim 110b. Yuḥasin under yod includes R. Yoḥanan of the valley of Beit Ḥ[...], in R. Yoḥanan's time, and under nun, Neḥemyah of that valley, in Sukkah: he assigns one document to two people. Our reading, however, is R. Neḥunya. [The source's abbreviated ב״ח place-name is retained without harmonization.]
